objective: Pipeline the M125 K4 weight-mux and four-source reduction path without changing its reset-free accepted-cycle behavior or numeric result, while adding explicit reset isolation.

motivation.dc_frontend_observation: M125 elaborates a 12288-bit register cache, four 16-to-1 768-bit muxes and a four-source lane reduction in one output path
motivation.repair: predecode canonical groups once per row; register two signed10 pair sums for all 96 lanes; leave only one signed10-plus-signed10 operation in the output stage
motivation.reset_repair: gate fill, row and update visibility while reset is asserted

architecture.elastic_behavior: one-entry pair-sum pipeline holds data, selection and address stable under downstream backpressure

paper_safe_statement: Commercial VCS verifies that M127 inserts a 1,920-bit pair-sum pipeline into the K4 fold while retaining M125's positive accepted-cycle behavior across 507 checked cycles and exact numeric outputs across 16,896 lanes, including a four-update II=1 sequence and reset isolation. Frequency, area and physical speedup remain unadmitted until matched Synopsys synthesis.
prohibited_claims: Do not claim frequency or physical speedup from the RTL pipeline structure or VCS result.
Do not call the behavioral 1536-byte cache a foundry macro.
Do not claim end-to-end, system, energy or FPS improvement.
Do not combine the M122 cycle projection with an unmeasured M127 frequency multiplier.
